parameters.command: test -d /Volumes/media/backups/qdrant || { echo "NAS backup path missing - is /Volumes/media mounted?"; exit 1; }; for c in second_brain shadow_log; do   curl -s -X POST http://localhost:6333/collections/$c/snapshots > /dev/null;  mkdir -p /Volumes/media/backups/qdrant/$c;  for f in /Users/kp-srv-01/Documents/docker/qdrant/snapshots/$c/*.snapshot; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue;    cp -n "$f" /Volumes/media/backups/qdrant/$c/ 2>/dev/null; done;  ls -t /Users/kp-srv-01/Documents/docker/qdrant/snapshots/$c/*.snapshot 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 |    while read -r f; do rm -f "$f" "$f.checksum"; done;  ls -t /Volumes/media/backups/qdrant/$c/*.snapshot 2>/dev/null | tail -n +15 | xargs -r rm -f; done
